нежить is the verb «to pamper» (нежный) as well as «the undead»; it keeps its bare roots.
воротный belongs with ворота, not with вращение.
прихожая (entrance hall) is not the parish (прихожанин).
треба, требник (rite, missal) and отребье, непотребный keep no sense; they are not требовать.
Reviewed orphans that rightly stand apart from the senses of their family: вид (view, species) is not видеть; numerals, compounds, homonyms and loanwords keep their bare root.
родный keeps its reviewed derived root (родные «relatives»): a sense would bypass reviewed_derived_roots.tsv and leave it rootless.
Reviewed orphan (sense_orphan_queue.tsv) that stands apart from its family senses: another meaning, a loanword or a homonym.
свить stays apart: its form «свиты» is also the noun свита, and a winding sense would let развиваться open «свиты».
невидимый stays on the bare root with вид (correctness label невидимый → вид OK).
превзойти is surpassing, like превосходить, not walking.
«количество» is a noun of amount, not the question/pronoun «сколько» family; «несколько» is open from the start and must not reveal it.
Narrow reviewed semantic subfamilies. Keep the broader technical roots (септ, сульф, хлор, хим) split: these are lexical families, not global opaque roots or substring rules.
Назначение на должность / назначение прибора: the noun also names a purpose, so it opens предназначенный as well as назначить.
Orphans batch F7: приближённо is «approximately».
«Бой» is the battle noun: it opens боевой, боец, битва, but not бить. The -бойный/-бойник words name hitting (прибой, сбой, обои, пробой), not combat, so they go with their bases in sense:beat.
начальный (initial) is начало, not начальник.
«вязать» is genuinely polysemous: physical binding and knitting are both valid game readings. The participle/adjective «вяжущий» is kept in the narrower knitting cluster above.
«справить свадьбу», «справлять именины»: holding an occasion, not an inquiry (справка).

The ган/гн/гон family had no split at all. Chasing, catching up, racing, overtaking, distilling, persecution, exile, driving away, herding, fitting, acceleration, hijacking, run/stage, hounds and -гонный remedies are separate senses.
чит/чет: сочетать and чета (a married couple) are joining, not чёткий.
Trust/belief and confidence are different modern uses of вер-. The negative forms inherit their base's sense from the negation pass.
The свят family had no split: dedicating or initiating (посвятить), consecrating (освятить), the clergy and Christmastide separate from holiness itself.
Legal entrusting/delegation is narrower than belief or ordinary trust.
The -ый spelling of бредовой came in by spelling fallback without the sense.
The broad тереб/треб bucket contains both demanding and consuming / using. Keep explicit subfamilies instead of relying on the spelling.
суд² (vessel) is unrelated to суд¹ and its modern words drifted apart: tableware, anatomical vessels and ships are separate senses.

Religious service is a narrow lexicalized subfamily. Keep only the exact богослуж- pair here: священнослужитель and церковнослужитель have different full compound structures and must not be merged by this sense.
«есть» belongs to the eating action. The noun «еда» has its own food sense above; article context can separately select «быть».
образование is schooling and also forming (образование звезд).
Electricity, the adjective and the adverb are one sense, apart from the electron particle and electronics.
Среда as surroundings or a day of the week does not mean an average.
существо is «по существу» (essence) and a creature, not existing.
Исключительный is "exceptional / exclusive", not the act of excluding.
Исключать is the opposite action; keep it apart from включать.
Исключение is an act of excluding or an exception to a rule.
These тор- derivatives have distinct current meanings: acquired expertise, making a path, a blockage, and generosity.
Split the broad пад family by current meaning. The grammatical term падеж must not share a game root with inflections of падать.
The noun «еда» is food; it is not the action «есть» = consume.

Основа is both a foundation and the main part; состоять can describe a state or what something is composed of. Keep the neighboring senses separate while allowing these two bridging lemmas in both families.
A frame or mount (оправа очков, оправка). «оправить» / «оправлять» also mean tidying clothes (see MULTI_READINGS).
приучить/отучить form or break a habit.

Half itself, including the half carcass (полть, полоток) and the half-coin полушка. Kuznetsova's «по́лоть» (carcass) and «полка» (small пола) are spelled like the weeding verb and the shelf, which keep their own clusters.
мешать and помешать both hinder and stir.
мешать and помешать both hinder and stir.
The broad take/borrow family also contains hiring, engaging in an activity, removable objects, and land near a river.
почести are honors; почтенный is also its participle.
честный, честность and бесчестье share честь: honor and honesty, root:honor.
Особа and особь name a single being, not a peculiarity.

Arabic numeral spellings are explicit members of the corresponding cardinal roots. Keep the additions narrow: ordinals retain their existing grammar relations and do not become a transitive digit graph.
учить, ученик, учитель and учебник are one schooling cluster.
Orphans batch F7: следствие is also «последствие», показаться also «казаться» (мне показалось), происшествие is what произошло.
The един family had no split: joining (соединить, присоединение), the unit (единица), the sole or united (единственный, единство), solitude (уединение, наедине) and the duel (поединок) separate.
The ladle in modern use; the archaic sharecropper is the other reading.
Разложить/разложение cover both decomposition and placing things out.
Families with no sense: carve the minority meaning, the rest stays as is.
The productive стир- laundry derivatives share the existing стирка cluster. Простирать remains ambiguous between washing and extending.
пуск: one sense:let was too broad (выпускник opened запущенный). The base verbs пускать/пустить keep both let and launch (MULTI_READINGS).
The dictionary also analyzes the one-letter name of Е as a rare present-tense form of быть. In Censorly, the standalone letter is its own lexical sense; do not attach it to the быть family.
пустить: let in and set going; запущенный: launched and neglected.
Split the свет family: emitted light, lamps, illumination, brightness and pale colour, a gap (просвет), spiritual clarity, titles, fireflies, rooms and endearments are separate senses.
A limit (предел, запредельный) and an appanage or lot (удел, удельный) are not acts of dividing.
The ниж/низ family had no split: low position and lowering stay together, while lowland geography, humiliation and baseness separate.
Низменный is both low-lying (terrain) and base (conduct).
«Основной» describes priority or importance; «основать» is to found.
A confirmed report: изображались must not open «образом» (таким образом), so образ stays manner only.
непосредственный shares посредство with опосредствованный (correctness label OK).
Намерить is measuring a quantity; намереваться expresses intention.
The historical label for a middle peasant has a separate modern meaning from a spatial middle or an average value.
современный is «modern», not a kind of time.
поучительный is moralising, not schooling.
«Знатный» describes status, not cognition. Only the homograph «знать» (verb / collective noun) retains both readings in MULTI_READINGS.
Kuznetsova audit K1 (2026-11-17): doubt (сомневаться) is сомнение and мнение, not remembering (упоминать).
The сад/сед/сид bucket put every сад- and саж- word under the garden. The garden keeps сад itself; seating and planting (сажать, посадить) are one causative cluster, and lexicalized nouns separate.
The pronoun наш is not нести.
Перегнать машину / перегнать спирт; пригнать скот / пригнать деталь; подгонять лошадь / подгонять размер.
Частный is private or partial; причастие is communion or a participle.
Слить воду / слить компании; отлив is both ebb tide and pouring off.
«воспроизводить» and its derivatives belong to sense:reproduction.
слово: proverbs, dictionaries, prefaces and philology are apart from the word itself (слово, словесный, дословный, словечко).
Separate reasoning/discussion, gossip, lending and irrationality from the court family while retaining the common historical root.
Getting over an illness or a shock: оправиться, поправиться.
The broad сто-/ста- bucket contains the act/state of leaving and the residue/remnant meaning. Keep those as separate semantic subfamilies.
«Свойство» and its adjectival derivatives mean an attribute; the possessive «свой» stays separate from kinship, mastery and appropriation.
банк (bank) is not банка (jar).
синий stays apart from синяк (homonym review test); the s1 label синячок → синий OK is a known loss.
Correctness sample s3 borderline pairs, closed by user decision (2026-11-10): a shared school root, but no link a player would see. столица (capital) is not стол/столяр (user decision 2026-11-10).
Reviewed карт, оруд/оруж and мер families: spelling alone must not connect pictures to cards, construction to tools, or intent to measure.
Провести/проводить mean carrying out an event or conducting current, not leading somebody somewhere; проводы are a farewell.
Проводить мероприятие / проводить друга.
прекратить is stopping, not shortness (короткий, сократить, краткий).
четкий (clear, precise) is not читать/считать.
соитие is not сойтись/идти.
Наиболее forms superlatives like более forms comparatives.
заговор (conspiracy) and приговор (verdict) are not говорить.
продолжать (continue) is not долгий/долго.
несметный (countless) is not смета or метить.
Cowardice (трус¹), apart from the shaking трус²/трус³ families.
трус is a coward and, archaically, an earthquake; трусить is to be afraid and to shake or trot.
сутки (24 hours) is not точка/стык.

This 213-lemma historical family mixes movement with transitions, entrances, routes, work, and figurative meanings. Keep those nouns and adjectives in smaller modern-sense clusters; the verbs below retain multiple readings where the ordinary movement sense is still live.
считаться and счесть mean «to be regarded, to deem», apart from counting (счет); считать and посчитать read both.
One spelling, several modern meanings. Keeping the readings separate lets a surface participate in each appropriate cluster without joining the clusters themselves.
зависеть (depend) is not висеть.
пустын-, пустош- and пустыр- are related spellings but distinct modern lexical clusters. Their separate roots prevent component spelling from turning a desert into a vacant lot.
назвать is the perfective of называть: naming, not calling (звать, вызвать).
Dismissal (уволить) is not will and freedom (воля, невольник). позволить («дать волю») stays: s3 labels неволя → позволять OK.
смещение/сместить (shift, offset, removal from a post) is not перемещение/разместить (moving, placing).
Удаление can be an act of moving something away or removing it; удалённый likewise means either remote or deleted.
Enlightenment/education is not the physical-light family. Keep these forms out of sense:light so «свет» does not open them.
A prefixed -йти verb reads the senses of its -ходить partner, and semantic_roots.tsv gives it both the и and the ход root, so выйти opens выходить and выход.
смета (cost estimate) is not метить/заметить; the мет family lists it by spelling.
Exclamation and clicking share the modern клик/клиц/клич root family, but are distinct semantic subclusters.
чрезвычайный (extraordinary) is not привычка/навык.
Track F batch 1 (2026-11-09): frequent corpus words that opened an unrelated modern sense of their dictionary family. лик/лиц/лич: a face is not a person, presence, evidence or decency.

Article-play review: these are explicit modern lexical families. They deliberately override the broad historical root families below; this is not a substring or pair-edge rule.
постепенный (gradual) is not степень/степенной (power, degree).
«произойти» is both «случиться» and «вести род» (произошёл от обезьяны), the second shared with происходить and происхождение.
сопка (hill) is not сыпать/насыпь.
Охота is hunting or wanting (охота поесть).
Batch B7: впечатлить is what впечатление comes from.
наитие (inspiration) is not найти/идти.
только (only, just) is not столько/толика.
причитать (to lament) is not читать or причитаться (be due).
Track F batch 2 (user decision 2026-11-09): these must not open their historical relatives. уровень (level) is not равный/уравнение/сравнение.
строчка is a line of text (строка) and a line of stitches (прострочить).
поместье/помещик (landed estate, landowner) are not помещение/поместить.
Pouring keeps лить/полить/налить; merging, metal casting, cream and the bay/tide geography are lexicalized meanings of the same root.
Nursery «мама» is reviewed into the мать root (SEMANTIC_ROOT_ASSIGNMENTS) and takes the mother sense, apart from матка and the profanity words.
The common root «вещ» covers both concrete objects and substances. Keep their established derivatives with the matching modern meaning.
«происходить» also means «вести род» (происходит из дворян), so it stays with происхождение in sense:review_outcome_origin.
хорь (polecat) is not хор (choir, хоровод).
пожалуйста/пожалуй (please, perhaps) are not жалость or жалованье.
появиться reads both явиться/явный and появление: correctness s1/s3 label явно → появиться OK.
нажать, выжать, отжать, дожать, прожать, пережать are pressing only, though both жать families list them.
предыдущий (previous) is not идти/пройти.
Печать is printing or a seal; распечатать prints out or unseals.
продовольствие (food supply) is not воля/позволять.
сметливый (quick-witted, from смекать) is not метить/заметить.
сыпь (skin rash) and сыпной тиф are not сыпать (pour).
Retail (розница) is not разный.
пройдоха (rogue) is not пройти.
четки (rosary beads) is not читать/считать.
The unprefixed and perfective -гнить verbs are absent from the root dictionary; spelling fallback put them under гнать (гниют/отгоняет). SEMANTIC_ROOT_ASSIGNMENTS gives them the гни root explicitly.
степенный (sedate) is not степень/постепенный.
казаться (to seem) is not приказ/указ/заказ.
The historical сл/сыл family contains several distinct modern meanings. Keep message/mission, expulsion, and imposition separate; this is a semantic review, not a universal prefix rule.
розетка (socket, rosette) is not роза.
супруг (spouse) is not упругий; петух is not петь/песня.
«Состоять» belongs with «состояние», while «составить» is composition.
воскресенье is the day of the week; воскресение / воскрешение are resurrection. The dictionary's historical крес family merges them.
Correctness sample s4 (2026-11-17). Swelling (опухоль, пухнуть) is not fluff (пух, подпушка); trimming with fur (опушать) is fluff, not the forest edge (опушка).
Batch B6: the bird (индейка, индюк) is not the people (индеец, индейский).
близнец (twin) is not близкий/приближение.
подполье/подпольщик (clandestine underground) is not пол (floor).
вплоть («вплоть до», up to) is not плотный.
A village is a place; поселиться/переселить/население name acts of settling and the people it produces (split by prefix in _classify_review_lemma).
поселок is a village (село) and a settlement (поселение, поселиться).
Preserve both ordinary movement and the newly separated figurative senses within the хаж|ход|хож|хожд family.

Correctness sample s1 (2026-11-09): BAD openings fixed family-wide; the sample is drawn from the holdout, so s1 now overstates precision. тк/ток²/точ²: weaving (ткать) and poking (ткнуть, стык) are not точка.
The lemma «весь» also has the historical ethnonym reading from a separate dictionary family. Keep that alternative while assigning the common determiner/adjective to its modern «whole» sense.
Широта is both latitude and breadth; конечность is a limb or finiteness.
The written message retains its dedicated reading, while also participating in the broader writing family.
обогащать is the imperfective of обогатить: wealth, not god.
The side and the political wing. «правый» itself is also «being right» (see MULTI_READINGS); «неправый» is only that, wrong or unjust.
A rule and being right by it is not editing: «править» must not open «неправильно».
The жал-/жалован- spelling covers several synchronically unrelated families: salary, pity, complaint, and stinging. Keep the split at family level so an inflected form inherits the same decision.
учёный is a scientist: science, not a lesson.
Печать covers printing, the seal and its stamping, a typo, an imprint and the colloquial «упечатать» (lock up).
Пересадка is a transplant or a change of trains; посадка is planting, seating or a plane landing; насаждение is a planting or imposing.
A narrower modern meaning of serving obsequiously. Ordinary service words (служба, услуга, обслуживание) stay on the broad family because they bridge this meaning with literal service.
Setting a dislocated joint back in place (вправить вывих).
Working land «исполу», for half of the harvest.
The adjectival «данный» means specified / in question, not a transfer.
Распространение is spreading, not space: it must not open пространство.
Steam-related «паровой» is a homonym of «пара» meaning a pair.

Flowing keeps течь/протекать/вытекать. Streams, inflow and outflow, drains, channels, electric current, edema, streamlining, molasses, the forerunner, estrus and running away do not open the verbs of flowing or each other.
«Простираться» describes extent. The dictionary also lists an old washing reading, but that must not connect the ordinary word to тереть.
изучать is «research, examine», not schooling.
проучить is to punish («я его проучу»).

The root-family review for дв contains 53 dictionary lemmas. Keep the ordinary numeral and its doubling derivatives together, while the birth sense (двойня) and lookalike sense (двойник) form separate clusters.
Growing keeps расти/вырасти/рост; a plant, age and adulthood, an industry branch and usury are lexicalized meanings of the same root.

Metrology and checking belong with the existing проверить/сверить cluster, not with вера. Поверить is ambiguous (believe/check), so it stays in the belief cluster until readings can be reviewed separately.

Split the broad вес/веш family: weight as a property, the act of weighing, a suspension (взвесь), outweighing, short weight, plumb lines, sagging/air-curing and the many hanging senses no longer share a root.
